title: headcount-sync-hiring-loop-prep-notes
content:
Meeting: Headcount sync / hiring loop prep
Owner: Sofia Chen (eng-serving-runtime)
Date: 2026-03-02 10:00am PT (prep) / 2026-03-03 headcount sync
Attendees (tentative): Maya, Liam, Ethan, Sofia, HR recruiting partner (Anya)

Goals for this doc:
- Quick summary of open reqs and priority (what we need approved this quarter vs backlog)
- Confirm interview loop templates for SWE3 / SWE4 / Staff eng candidates on serving runtime
- Align on debrief process + decision SLA (post-interview + hiring manager next steps)
- Action items for recruiting + hiring managers after sync

CURRENT HEADCOUNT & PRIORITIES
- FY26 hiring target for eng-serving-runtime: +9 FTEs (Q1–Q2 ramp)
- Committed / approved this quarter: 4 (2 SWE3, 1 SWE4, 1 infra SRE)
- Pipeline (active candidates): 12 total (3 in loop, 5 in screen, 4 offer stage)
- Critical roles to prioritize this week: 
  - SWE4: model inference performance (blocking team capacity for quantization work)
  - SWE3: runtime ops (2 reqs)
  - SRE (infra): 1 req (on-call coverage and autoscaling work)

REQS (short notes)
- REQ-1024 SWE4 (model inference perf) — Hiring manager: Sofia
  - Priority: High (product roadmap dependency)
  - Req status: Approved, posting live (recruiter: Anya)
  - Interviewers lined up: Liam (system design), Maya (perf), Ethan (runtime internals)
  - Target close: 4 weeks
- REQ-1031 SWE3 (runtime ops) — Hiring manager: Liam
  - Priority: Medium
  - Need to validate loop: add a short live-debug exercise (30m)? Discuss below
- REQ-1040 SRE — Hiring manager: Ethan
  - Priority: High for Q2 on-call planning

INTERVIEW LOOP TEMPLATES / CHANGES (serving-runtime)
- SWE3 (standardized): phone screen (30m, recruiter) -> tech screen (45m, coding + systems fundamentals) -> onsite loop (4 x 60m): coding (pairing), system design (runtime), debugging exercise (runtime logs + KV cache), behavioral (team fit)
  - Add: 30m live debugging exercise for SWE3 (to validate production debugging + tracing) — new item, ask for recruiting support to include in template
- SWE4: phone screen -> technical system design deep-dive (90m) -> onsite loop (3 x 75m): architecture review, distributed systems/perf, leadership + roadmap discussion
  - For SWE4 we need to include a short take-home perf optimization prompt (2–3 hours) that candidates complete before onsite; hiring managers must commit to scoring rubric
- SRE: phone screen -> infra deep-dive -> on-call simulation (45m) -> behavior/culture

DEBRIEF + DECISION PROCESS (proposed)
- Debrief form: use recruiting's standard debrief (linked above). Expect all interviewer feedback + scorecard within 24 hours of last loop stage.
- Decision SLA: Hiring manager decision + comp range proposal within 48 hours after last interviewer feedback. Recruiter to prepare initial comp band options within 24 hours of decision.
- If split feedback: schedule 30m alignment call (hiring manager + 2 interviewers + recruiter) within 48 hrs.

OPEN QUESTIONS / DISCUSSION ITEMS FOR SYNC
- Can we increase approved headcount for Q2 if pipeline looks strong? (need finance signoff)
- Pooling interviews: can we reuse existing referee panel from applied-ml for perf-focused interviews? Pros/cons: reduces interviewer burden but may lose team-context insights
- Interviewer training: plan short 30m calibration session for new interviewers (Maya to coordinate)

RISK / BLOCKERS
- Recruiting capacity: Anya can only support 6 active reqs concurrently — need TA uplift or reprioritize reqs
- Compensation bands: SWE4 comps for market (SF competitive) may push offer above current approved band; pre-approval process with finance takes ~1 week
- Onsite capacity: limited slots week of 3/22 due to conf (relevant for target close dates)

ACTION ITEMS (owner -> due)
- Sofia: finalize SWE4 take-home prompt + rubric; share with recruiting by 2026-03-05
- Anya (recruiter): post REQ-1024 public and start scheduling initial screens; confirm interviewer availability by 2026-03-06
- Maya: schedule interviewer calibration session (30m) and draft one-pager on debrief expectations; due 2026-03-08
- Liam: propose 30m live-debug exercise outline for SWE3 (include evaluation checklist); due 2026-03-04
- Ethan: confirm SRE on-call simulation steps and tooling (pagerduty scenario + prometheus graphs); due 2026-03-07
- Recruiting/Finance: clarifying meeting on comp bands for SWE4 (Sofia + Anya + finance rep); schedule by 2026-03-04
- All interviewers: complete recruiter interview training module (Link in linked_artifacts) prior to first loop slot

NOTES / TEXT SNIPPETS TO COPY INTO CONFLUENCE:
- Q1 headcount ask summary (copy to confluence page): 
  - "Eng-serving-runtime requests 9 hires for FY26 (Q1–Q2), critical: 1 SWE4 (inference perf), 2 SWE3 (runtime ops), 1 infra SRE. Pipeline healthy but recruiter capacity limits speed. Proposed debrief SLA: 24h feedback, 48h hiring decision."

POTENTIAL FOLLOW-UPS AFTER SYNC:
- Confirm which reqs we deprioritize if recruiting capacity remains at 6 active reqs
- Ask finance for contingency approval for one market-exceeding SWE4 offer (fast-track)
- Book recurring 1:1 hiring sync (weekly, 30m) between hiring managers + recruiter starting 2026-03-09

QUICK LINKS (to paste in calendar invite)
- Confluence headcount plan: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HR/Headcount+Plan+2026
- Debrief template (recruiting): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HR/Debrief+Template
- Interview templates repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hiring/tree/main/interview-templates

Notes to self: keep this doc informal, update after sync with decisions + new owners. If we get finance pre-approval for SWE4 comp, move that req to top priority and accelerate interviews.
